a: Design awards up to $2,000,000/yr for up to 2 years (up to $32,000,000 in total for the Design phase); Implementation awards up to $10,000,000/yr for 6 years, subject to appropriations
dt: Full proposal target date Apr 6, 2027 for both Design and Implementation proposals (NSF 24-586). Contact the NQVL program officers at least 2 weeks before submitting.
e: Design- and Implementation-phase proposals for use-inspired quantum testbeds (Quantum Science and Technology Demonstration projects). A Design proposal requires an existing QSTD:Pilot project in the same topical area with a positive design review, and an Implementation proposal requires an existing QSTD:Design project; Pilot proposals are not solicited. Program officer consultation required.
n: NSF National Quantum Virtual Laboratory (NQVL) – Quantum Testbeds
